newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber closes sharply up, charts seen bullish.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber closes sharply up, charts seen bullish.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed higher to sharply higher, boosted by increasingly bullish sentiment on charts as key levels were breached, dealers said.
"When you look at 10-, 20-, 40-day moving averages we just blew through everything and didn't look back at all," said Smith Barney Forest Products analyst Neil Schmaedick.
There was also some talk that a leading Canadian mill may be planning some cutbacks.
September closed up $8.00 at $364.90 per thousand board feet following a $10-limit advance Monday. The 40-day moving average, as of Tuesday's close, stood at $359.29.
Floor sources said Cargill Investor Services was a featured buyer of September.
